items.source: Create a new JndiPropertySource with the given name and a JndiLocatorDelegate configured to prefix any names with "java:comp/env/".
items.translation: 创建一个新的JndiPropertySource，并指定名称以及一个配置为以"java:comp/env/"前缀任何名称的JndiLocatorDelegate。

items.source: By default, the underlying JndiLocatorDelegate will be configured with its "resourceRef" property set to true, meaning that names looked up will automatically be prefixed with "java:comp/env/" in alignment with published JNDI naming conventions. To override this setting or to change the prefix, manually configure a JndiLocatorDelegate and provide it to one of the constructors here that accepts it. The same applies when providing custom JNDI properties. These should be specified using JndiAccessor.setJndiEnvironment(java.util.Properties) prior to construction of the JndiPropertySource.
items.translation: 默认情况下，底层的 `JndiLocatorDelegate` 将配置其"resourceRef"属性为true，这意味着查找的名称将自动以"java:comp/env/"作为前缀，符合已发布的JNDI 命名约定。若要覆盖此设置或更改前缀，请手动配置一个 `JndiLocatorDelegate` 并将其提供给此处接受它的任一构造函数。提供自定义 JNDI 属性时也是如此。这些属性应在构建 `JndiPropertySource` 之前使用JndiAccessor.setJndiEnvironment(java.util.Properties)指定。

items.source: Note that StandardServletEnvironment includes a JndiPropertySource by default, and any customization of the underlying JndiLocatorDelegate may be performed within an ApplicationContextInitializer or WebApplicationInitializer.
items.translation: 注意，StandardServletEnvironment 默认包含一个 JndiPropertySource，并且可以在 ApplicationContextInitializer 或 WebApplicationInitializer 中对底层的 JndiLocatorDelegate 进行自定义。

items.source: This implementation looks up and returns the value associated with the given name from the underlying JndiLocatorDelegate. If a NamingException is thrown during the call to JndiLocatorDelegate.lookup(String), returns null and issues a DEBUG-level log statement with the exception message.
items.translation: 此实现从底层的JndiLocatorDelegate查找并返回与给定名称关联的值。如果在调用JndiLocatorDelegate.lookup(String)期间抛出NamingException，则返回null并记录一条 DEBUG 级别的日志语句，包含异常消息。

items.source: Create a new JndiPropertySource with the given name and the given JndiLocatorDelegate.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `JndiPropertySource`，使用给定的名称和给定的 `JndiLocatorDelegate`。
